scope: Full-source meaning review of explicitly scoped summaries: one faithful control, one clear action-order violation, and two existing repaired notes with no prespecified gold verdict.
acceptance: The two controls must parse with literal change excerpts and have expected preserved labels. Diagnostic verdicts are observations, not automatically source truth or approval. Replay every raw verdict through the unchanged real parser/runtime; do not tune prompts or repair outputs.
stop: Stop after four native review tasks.
limits: Native task-file prompt-text delivery is not verified original-provider system/user role, temperature or token-limit delivery.
Two controls are lead-authored; actual repaired notes reuse known cases. No held-out quality claim or human comprehension evidence.
Shared filesystem access is constrained by instruction only.
Exact backend revision, token use and costs unknown.
